about: Dynamic code in vendored files, reviewed to ship under the extension CSP (#27 AC6). scripts/build/csp.js runs ESLint's no-eval, no-new-func, and no-implied-eval on every shipped script: first-party code may have none, and each vendored file only the occurrences a row counts. A row pins the file's SHA-256, so it changes only with its dependency: a new version fails until its occurrences are reviewed again.

rows.reason: The setimmediate polyfill JSZip bundles turns a callback that isn't a function into one with new Function("" + callback). JSZip only passes it functions, so the constructor never runs here.

@protobufjs/inquire looks for Node's require with eval("quire".replace(/^/, "re")) inside a try. Under the extension CSP the eval throws, the catch returns null, and protobuf.js carries on without it.
webpack's global-object lookup returns globalThis when it exists and only otherwise tries new Function("return this")(). Chrome has globalThis, so the constructor never runs.
